name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Commission delegated regulation of 3 November 2025 amending Delegated Regulation (EU) 2020/1818 as regards the definition of prohibited weapons
part_text:
The European Parliament is blocking a European Commission rule that narrows which weapons count as "prohibited" for EU green investment labels. The Parliament says the new definition is too limited: it leaves out weapons such as white phosphorus, depleted uranium and nuclear weapons. The Parliament asks the Commission to write a new rule that keeps the green label trustworthy while giving investors legal certainty.

- **What changes:** The Commission's narrower weapons definition cannot enter into force.
- **Who it affects:** Investors and funds that use EU climate and Paris-aligned benchmark labels.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must propose a new rule; the Parliament's President tells the Commission and Member States.
